description: Bounded full-state-space semantic contract for six Ping actors and six Pong actors in the untimed Mesh Ping-Pong benchmark.

semantic_backend.reason: The system is concurrent and message-amplifying. Evaluation uses reachable graph witnesses and topology/routing invariants rather than requiring a small closed recurrent state-space.

timing_abstraction.logical_meaning: Each Ping role has an autonomous recurring trigger that delivers the logical Ping event repeatedly.
timing_abstraction.required_effect: The target must preserve an autonomous recurring trigger, implemented by a self-message or an auxiliary scheduler rebec, that causes the same two-neighbor broadcast.

topology.description: Each Ping has exactly two fixed Pong neighbors and each Pong is shared by exactly two Ping roles. Up to renaming, the communication graph is a 12-node bipartite cycle.

observable_protocol.startup: Each Ping emits one Ping request to each of its two fixed Pong neighbors.
observable_protocol.periodic_trigger: Each Ping has recurring autonomous untimed activity that produces the same two-neighbor broadcast.
observable_protocol.pong_reply: A Pong consuming a request from Ping i sends exactly one Pong reply to Ping i.
observable_protocol.reply_induced_rebroadcast: A Ping consuming Pong emits one Ping request to each of its two fixed neighbors.
observable_protocol.amplification: One Pong reply to a Ping creates two new Ping requests. This fan-out is intended source behavior.

representation_policy.names: Target class, rebec, and message-server names are not semantic identifiers.
representation_policy.ping_roles: Six distinct Ping sender roles must remain observable.
representation_policy.pong_roles: Six distinct Pong reply-server roles must remain observable.
representation_policy.message_encoding: Ping/Pong may be renamed or typed differently; evaluator discovery uses mailbox deltas and sender/recipient relations.
representation_policy.scheduler_encoding: The periodic trigger may be a self-message or auxiliary scheduler rebec.

state_space_limit_policy.principle: Observed contradictions are FAIL. Missing positive witnesses are NOT_OBSERVED, because exported state-space may be incomplete for this message-amplifying benchmark.

excluded_from_equivalence: fairness stronger than bounded observed witnesses

tests.description: Each Ping has an autonomous startup witness producing exactly two requests to two fixed Pong neighbors.
Each Ping has a recurring autonomous non-Pong trigger witness producing the same two-neighbor broadcast.
Each Ping has a connected Pong-reply to two-neighbor-rebroadcast witness.
Each Pong consuming a request sends exactly one reply to the request sender.
All observed broadcasts from a Ping use the same two Pong neighbors.
Six Ping roles and six Pong roles are behaviorally observed.
Every Ping has degree two and every Pong has degree two in the logical bipartite graph.
The discovered 6x6 bipartite topology is connected and 2-regular.
All six Ping roles have startup broadcast witnesses.
A Pong reply returns to the exact Ping sender, never another Ping.
Each Ping has a connected reply-to-two-request fan-out witness.
At least one state enables protocol progress for two distinct logical actors.
The protocol exposes six Ping roles and six Pong roles; auxiliaries are ignored.
All six Ping roles reach startup broadcast without semantic-harness intervention.
All six Ping roles expose recurring autonomous untimed scheduler activity.
A Pong reply to a Ping can produce two new Ping requests to that Ping's fixed neighbors.
Topology, startup, periodic trigger abstraction, reply routing, fixed fan-out, rebroadcast, and concurrency are all preserved.
